claims.claim: Approximately 900 individuals are advertised for commercial sex online in Nebraska each month; roughly 15% show high-risk trafficking indicators, and 75% of those trafficked in Nebraska are Nebraskans.
claims.source: Creighton University Human Trafficking Initiative / HTI Labs, Nebraska's Commercial Sex Market (funded by Women's Fund of Omaha / Sherwood Foundation)
claims.expiry: Vintage-limited: figures rest on 2017-era Backpage data. Backpage was seized in 2018, so the underlying market has shifted.
red_team_flags: Vintage: original analysis is 2017-era Backpage data. Check HTI Labs for post-Backpage updates before using in federal proposals, or frame explicitly as 'landmark prevalence research.'

claims.claim: NCMEC's CyberTipline received more than 546,000 reports of online enticement in 2024 — a 192% increase over 2023 and a twelve-fold increase since 2021.
claims.expiry: NCMEC releases annual CyberTipline data each spring; refresh with the 2025 full-year report (~spring 2026).

claims.claim: In 2024 NCMEC received nearly 100 reports of financial sextortion per day; since 2021 at least 36 teenage boys have died by suicide after being victimized.
In the first half of 2025, online enticement reports rose another 77% (to 518,720), and child sex trafficking reports surged to 62,891 following the REPORT Act's expanded mandatory reporting.
claims.expiry: Mid-year figure; supersede with NCMEC full-year 2025 report.
red_team_flags: Attribution: the trafficking-report surge is partly a reporting-mandate artifact (REPORT Act), not solely a prevalence increase. State this when using the figure.

claims.claim: Generative-AI-related exploitation reports to NCMEC increased 1,325% in 2024 — an emerging threat category for prevention education.
claims.expiry: Fast-moving category; refresh with NCMEC 2025 in Numbers.

claims.claim: Nebraska and Iowa National Human Trafficking Hotline counts and state AG task-force statistics.
claims.source: National Human Trafficking Hotline state reports (NE, IA); Nebraska AG NHTTF updates
red_team_flags: Hotline counts measure reporting/contact volume, not prevalence; frame accordingly.
